description: Slide & the Family Stone are a competitive mixed curling team based in Vancouver. We pride ourselves on strategic play, team chemistry, and good sportsmanship both on and off the ice. We are not related.

faq.question: Why the name?
faq.answer: It's funny. We didn't think too hard about it. Don't you think it's weird that curling team names have traditionally been the skip's last name?

faq.question: How do I start curling?
faq.answer: 3 of our team members are certified instructors and can help you get started. Best place to start is with a learn-to-curl program at Marpole or Vancouver Curling Club. There's also novice leagues. If you're brand new, consider a try curling session.

faq.question: Do you have any sponsors?
faq.answer: No, but we are open to sponsorship opportunities. We've got a really sweet uniform design kicking around, and we'd love to put your logo on our chest/sleeve/back. Get in touch!
